title: OpenAI Adds 6 New Languages in GPT-Live-1.1 Voice Update
summary:
A new update to the voice capabilities in ChatGPT, Codex, and dots began rolling out to all users on Oct 15, 2026, to improve conversation flow and linguistic range. The GPT-Live-1.1 release introduces support for 6 additional languages, including Hindi, Korean, Japanese, German, French, and Mexican Spanish, while refining accents to create more natural speech patterns.

The software refresh focuses on reducing conversational friction by minimizing the frequency of filler phrases such as "checking" or "let me check that," which previously occurred every few seconds. OpenAI will bring these voice enhancements to its API following the initial release to consumers.
